verses.1: I will not rouse him, as the cruel would do, for who is able to withstand my countenance?
verses.2: Who has given to me beforehand, so that I should repay him? All things that are under heaven are mine.
verses.3: I will not spare him, nor his powerful words and counterfeit attempts at supplication.
verses.4: Who can reveal the beauty of his garment? And who can enter the middle of his mouth?
verses.5: Who can open the doors of his face? I gave fear to the circle of his teeth.
verses.6: His body is like shields fused together, like dense scales pressed over one another.
verses.7: One is joined to another, and not even air can pass between them.
verses.8: They adhere to one another, and they hold themselves in place and will not be separated.
verses.9: His sneezing has the brilliance of fire, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.10: Lamps proceed from his mouth, like torches of fire burning brightly.
verses.11: Smoke passes out of his nostrils, like a pot that is heated and boiling.
verses.12: His breath causes coal to burn, and a flame comes forth from his mouth.
verses.13: Strength dwells in his neck, and destitution goes before his presence.
verses.14: The parts of his body work in harmony together. He will send lightning bolts against him, and they will not be carried to another place.
verses.15: His heart will be as hard as a stone and as dense as a blacksmith’s anvil.
verses.16: When he will be raised up, the angels will be afraid, and, because they are terrified, they will purify themselves.
verses.17: When a sword catches up with him, it will not be able to settle in, nor a spear, nor a breastplate.
verses.18: For he will consider iron as if it were chaff, and brass as if it were rotten wood.
verses.19: The archer will not cause him to flee; the stones of the sling have been turned into stubble for him.
verses.20: He will treat the hammer as if it were stubble, and he will ridicule those who brandish the spear.
verses.21: The beams of the sun will be under him, and he will dispense gold to them as if it were clay.
verses.22: He will make the depths of the sea boil like a pot, and he will set it to bubble just as ointments do.
verses.23: A path will shine after him; he will esteem the abyss as if it were weakening with age.
verses.24: There is no power on the earth that is being compared to him, who has been made so that he fears no one.
verses.25: He sees every prominent thing; he is king over all the sons of arrogance. [ Job 42 ]
